# The Calendar tooltip helper retains a title assertion without a message

In the changed checkTooltip helper, Assert.equal(getDescription(1), EVENTTITLE) has no third message argument. The following interval assertion supplies the row and column plus the expected date/time behavior. This is a scoped missing diagnostic in the title assertion, not evidence that the test failed or a reason to rewrite unrelated assertions. The helper is unchanged in the fixed accepted file; no test ran.

Scope: Calendar event tooltip test diagnostics.
